# The obee process dies while the run waits for the on-call answer. The next obee run finishes the same run. The finished steps do not repeat:
# the diagnostics are read once, the analyst runs once, and each role is paged once. The answer then arrives, and the mitigation runs once.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve rollback'
kill -KILL
wait

exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-incident-2-r1\trunning\tpaused: \[primary\] Approve rollback'
! exists writes.log

exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve rollback'
exec obeereal answer incident-2 approve: ann
wait
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

# One read of the metrics, one analyst call and one page for each purpose, across the two processes.
grep -count=1 'services/checkout/metrics' curl.log
grep -count=1 '^analyst$' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^incident-2 primary$' pages.log
grep -count=1 '^rollback incident-2-rollback$' writes.log
grep 'approved by ann' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-incident-2-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
{"fingerprint":"k1","severity":"sev1","title":"Checkout errors","service":"checkout","detail":"ROLLBACK error rate 40 percent after deploy v413"}
-- home/.incident/config --
OPS_API=http://ops.test
SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.incident/spool
INC_POLL=1
INC_MINUTE=1
INC_TICK=1
-- home/.incident/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_services_checkout_metrics --
{"error_rate":0.4}
-- resp/_services_checkout_deploys --
[]
-- resp/_services_checkout_logs --
line one
-- resp/_services_checkout_state --
{"version":"v413","replicas":3}
-- resp/_services_checkout_health --
{"healthy":true}
